{{Quote|There is nothing in this story to like. I'm sorry, but the sooner it's out of the public eye, the better.|critsym, on the story about Nightwing and Kulkis shared on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="everyone's a critic">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050331b|text=Everyone's a Critic}}</ref>}}
The handle '''critsym''' was the user ID of an individual who contributed on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the circulation<ref name="everyone's a critic" /> on the Cularin holonet<ref name="the best defense">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310b|text=The Best Defense}}</ref> of a short story in which the [[Thaereian military]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nightwing]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Gender/Legends|his]] superior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Kulkis]], critsym read and reviewed the tale. The user regarded the story as unlikeable and of poor literary quality.<ref name="everyone's a critic" />
